integrity.proof_basis: Analytic proof using the published superharmonic-majorant inequality, a strict majorant gap, finite-dimensional compactness, and Poisson/Fourier approximation.

scientific_limitations: The result is qualitative: no explicit formula or rate for \(1-C_N\) is established.
The claim concerns real trigonometric polynomials on the periodic circle, not a finite-band analogue on the real line.

title: Finite-band obstruction and sharp approximation for the periodic Hilbert transform's weak-\(L^\infty\) norm
